avis.titre: Korean skincare has transformed my skin!
avis.texte: Switching my routine over to Korean skincare has honestly been life-changing for my skin, and APRILSKIN has quickly become one of my favorite brands. This product leaves my skin feeling incredibly hydrated, smooth, and refreshed without feeling heavy. I’ve noticed such an improvement in my skin texture and overall glow since adding it into my routine. My skin feels softer, healthier, and more balanced. Absolutely love this product and will definitely continue repurchasing!

I absolutely love this stuff. This is legit a non-negotiable when it comes to my skin care routine (if you could even call it that, a skin care routine because im a bare minimum girly most the time) I do have chronically dry skin though and this is so moisturizing and hydrating, which in turn has helped tremendously with my fine lines and makes my skin look more glowy and supple. Seriously dont take my word for it, try it for yourself.

The APRILSKIN TXA+Niacinamide 99 Pink Milky Toner is a lightweight yet nourishing toner that helps brighten dull skin while improving overall texture and hydration. Formulated with 3% Tranexamic Acid (TXA) and 5% Niacinamide, it works well for fading dark spots, post-acne marks, and uneven skin tone without feeling harsh on sensitive skin. The milky texture absorbs quickly, leaving skin soft, smooth, and hydrated with a healthy glow rather than a greasy finish. With continued use, many users notice brighter and more balanced-looking skin. While results on deeper pigmentation may take time, it’s a gentle and effective addition to a daily skincare routine for anyone focused on radiance and tone correction.

avis.titre: combines a toner and a lotion into one
avis.texte: This milky toner is very unique because it combines a toner and a lotion into one. Instead of just giving the light, watery absorption of a regular toner, it also provides the protection and moisture of an emulsion, yet it remains lightweight, non-sticky, and adds an extra layer of skincare. While I haven't noticed any dramatic skin improvements, it works great as a standard, everyday basic moisturizer. Plus, the bottle is huge, making it well worth the price and definitely worth buying!

avis.titre: Oily to combo skin- Linda listen
avis.texte: I don’t say this lightly—the April Skin Is completely changing my face in just the short time that I've had it. my mind about what hydration is supposed to feel like, is not what it actually is. I have oily to combination skin, so I’m always careful with serums because a lot of them end up feeling heavy or greasy on me. This brand.... Not even close. It soaks in beautifully and leaves my skin feeling plump, smooth, and actually hydrated without that oily film sitting on top. And I look awake For the first time in 40 years I look awake. I used to avoid products that promised that “glowy” look because I thought it would just make me look shiny… but this is a healthy, lit-from-within glow—not grease. I’ve spent serious money on skincare over the years (I’m talking $40+ for a tiny bottle), and honestly, this serum holds its own against all of them. The price point for what you’re getting is kind of crazy. Since adding this into my routine, my skin looks more even, more awake, and just overall healthier. No irritation, no breakouts—just consistent, noticeable results. If you have oily or combo skin and you’re hesitant like I was, just try it. This serum might surprise you the way it did me.

I am extremely picky about skincare, it’s really hard for me to like a product because my skin is so picky! This toner is a huge love for me. It’s thick, no scent, hydrating and soaks into my skin beautifully. Before buying this, no matter what I did I’d wake up in the morning with my skin feeling dry and tight, but now I wake up feeling hydrating. I’m pleasantly surprised by how much I love this and am considering trying their other products.

avis.texte: I absolutely love this milky toner! The soft pink color makes it fun and a bit unique. It’s so gentle and pleasant to use - my skin feels instantly hydrated, soft, and super happy every time I apply it. It’s one of those products that feels like a little treat in your skincare routine. Such a great find!
Love this product! Just added to my routine! It’s light weight and works great! Difference in my skin was immediate!

I felt more like a heavy runny lotion rather than a lightweight clarifying toner. I guess I was just expecting a different consistency rather than a pink lotion so this had nothing to do with the product. It’s not just my speed of what I was looking for.

This is a very nice toner! It's different from any other toner I've tried, but I really like it. Instead of being clear and watery, it is milky and pink. It looks a lot like Pepto Bismol, but it is thinner, more like a milky consistency. It goes on so smoothly and feels moisturizing and refreshing rather than astringent. I am a big fan of niacinamide, but this is my first experience with tranexamic acid (TXA). This toner also has seven (7!) types of hyaluronic acid, which is my favorite moisturizing ingredient. Plus, there's panthenol, ceramides and vitamin C-- so many beauty benefit ingredients! I like the opening in the bottle, it's not exactly a dropper, but it is a small opening that lets you pour out just a little at a time, and a little is all you need. It doesn't take much of this toner to cover my face and neck, and if there is any left over in the palms of my hands, I spread it on my elbows and forearms. It feels so smooth and moisturizing. This toner reminds me of a toner and serum combined. It's thinner than a serum, but more moisturizing than a toner. I use it on just-washed skin and follow with my favorite moisturizer. Overall, this stuff is different, but I love it. It's also a fun pink color. It leaves my skin feeling so smooth and moisturized, and as someone with mature skin, I love the gentle acids for sloughing off dead skin cells to keep my skin as fresh as possible. Followed by my favorite face cream, it's a big win.

This is aesthetically attractive and easy to apply. It is a hydrating, milky toner. It acts as skincare, yet also helps to even out my skin and keep it hydrated. Basically, an all-in-one formula. It is comfortable to apply and spreads easily on the skin. After consistent use, my skin has visibly improved. My hyperpigmentation has evened out and my tone has improved. My pores are shrinking and the texture of my skin is softer. I am happy with the formula and my results.

The pink toner is great. It is creamy and goes on silky smooth. My face feels very soft and hydrated after using. My skin looks healthier with a more even tone. It’s gentle on my sensitive skin which I love. Very impressed with this product.

This has the look of pepto bismol. It’s a pretty pink color and has a thicker creamy consistency. It has a light pleasant scent and absorbs well but leaves skin feeling moisturized and healthy. Excellent toner!
